description: This file defines the UniqueFieldValueValidator class, which validates that a specific field value is unique within an entity type in Drupal, including handling case sensitivity and internal duplicates.

classes.name: UniqueFieldValueValidator
classes.description: A validator class that ensures a field value is unique for a given entity type in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects entity field manager and entity type manager services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of the validator with services from the container.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation to ensure field values are unique, checking against existing entities and within the current entity.

methods.name: caseInsensitiveArrayIntersect
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive intersection of two arrays, returning original capitalization.

methods.name: extractDuplicates
methods.description: Identifies duplicate values within the provided array, excluding the first occurrence.
